banner.title: PulseKRN 2.6 is here
banner.body: Meet the new Repair Center: Health Scan, Windows Update repair, Audio, Network, Disk Doctor, Battery, Drivers, Crashes, Recovery and Bluetooth tools in one place.
banner.link_desc: The full list of new tools and fixes in this release.

announcements.title: Welcome to PulseKRN news
announcements.body: Announcements from the PulseKRN team will pop up here: new features, important fixes and tips for keeping your PC healthy. Update checks run quietly every 3 hours, so you always hear about new versions first.
announcements.link_desc: Downloads, release notes and the latest news.

announcements.title: New: Repair Center
announcements.body: Windows Repair is now the Repair Center. Run a Health Scan to get a score and clear next steps, then fix only what is broken. Every repair asks before it changes anything, and nothing is ever removed from Windows.
announcements.link_desc: What each Repair Center tool does and when to use it.
